text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hm, this is... overweight,
is it?
I suppose banquets and dinners have been
rather frequent of late.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If ordinary training alone is not enough
to trim down—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Destruction. Allow me to invite you
to the garden of sweet ruin.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Behold.
Yonder stand a few superfluous paddock
fences.
Upon them, I shall—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I unleash a sweeping blow that grazes the
earth.
—Like this.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The fragments shattered by this single stroke
shall undergo transmigration,
honing its very essence into absolute
sharpness.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see. An exercise I would never normally
even think to attempt...
Though it strikes me as rather
unrefined...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Laughable.
In a realm secluded from this world,
there is no one to reprove us.
...What will you do?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
regarding the weight gain we spoke of
earlier...
It has been resolved.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No... it's nothing worth mentioning.
Just a fleeting thought.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rose Kingdom answered evasively.
Still, if the matter is resolved,
that's what matters most.
